name: OutputClause
docs:
An `OUTPUT` clause on `MERGE`, `INSERT`, `UPDATE`, or `DELETE` (MSSQL).

Example:
OUTPUT $action, deleted.* INTO dbo.temp_products;
<https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sql/t-sql/queries/output-clause-transact-sql>
